scientific_question: Can a compact continuous full-rank local atlas around the accepted Pair-VQ value chart represent the exact post-Muon MLP request and its held-out functional action?

causal_basis.teacher_forced_value_chart: The sealed Pair-VQ shadow follows the exact dense replay within +0.00382 CE, so value capacity on an externally supplied path is not the primary defect.
causal_basis.late_tangent_failure: The live discrete Pair-VQ chart recovers only about 0.0118 percent of late requested-update energy.
causal_basis.polar_sensitivity: Forward-visible center gradients reach about 0.99998 cosine before Muon, but the five-step polar map amplifies their error about fourfold.
causal_basis.closed_families: Low-rank, scalar damping, static BlockFHT, larger codebooks, and retraction-cadence variants did not close the causal 5TPP gap.
causal_basis.authorization: Only a zero-update same-replay representability ceiling is authorized; no language-model candidate, scale-up, or hyperparameter sweep is authorized.

theory.value_model: For each 768x768 panel, W = Q(c) + sum_s B_L,s(alpha_s) diag(d_s) B_R,s(beta_s)^T.
theory.full_rank_property: Every atom is generically full rank when its diagonal is nonzero; compactness comes from structured singular frames, not a low matrix rank.
theory.connectivity: Each B is a product of ten deterministic disjoint-Givens matchings at exact width 768. Connectivity is frozen by matrix identity, panel, side, atom, and seed; only angles and diagonals are fitted.
theory.coordinate_count: One atom uses 2*(10*384)+768 = 8448 continuous coordinates per 768x768 panel, exactly 69.81818x fewer values than an ambient panel. Two atoms use 16896, exactly 34.90909x fewer.
theory.request_projection: At the fitted value state phi, project the exact same-momentum post-polar dense Muon request U into J_phi by ridge least squares using matrix-free JVP, VJP, and conjugate gradient.
theory.functional_metric: Held-out c_fc action is GELU'(c_fc(x))*d_cfc(x) followed by the live dense c_proj; held-out c_proj action is d_cproj(GELU(c_fc(x))).
theory.interpretation: This is an expressivity ceiling. A pass licenses production implementation and systems gates only; a failure rejects this exact one/two-atom fixed-connectivity atlas.

frozen_protocol.training_parent: exact 124M QK-only dense-MLP synchronized replay, seed 1337, 238 updates, LR 0.0024, fixed data and schedule
frozen_protocol.muon_history: identical live dense momentum buffer and native five-step Newton-Schulz polar map
frozen_protocol.weight_base: live Pair-VQ materialized weight without the ambient FP16 feedback carry

atlas.selection_rule: Evaluate S=1 first. Evaluate S=2 only when S=1 fails a frozen local gate. Select the smallest S passing every gate at both late probes.

state_and_compute_contract.materialized_dense_weight: transient and already required by GEMM
state_and_compute_contract.candidate_checkpoint_state: Pair-VQ values plus atlas angles, diagonals, and compact optimizer state
required_future_report: structured materialization FLOPs and wall time

decision_rule.S1_pass: Seal the one-atom representability pass and authorize implementation, exact state/resume tests, and one exact-config MFU gate only.
decision_rule.S1_fail_S2_pass: Seal the two-atom capacity-ceiling pass and authorize implementation, exact state/resume tests, and one exact-config MFU gate only.
decision_rule.S2_fail: Reject this fixed-connectivity full-rank atlas without stage, seed, atom-count, LR, model-size, or horizon sweeps. Return to the preregistered conditional theory tree.

operations.expected_duration: more than five minutes because two late probes fit and project every MLP panel
operations.watchdog: one idempotent terminal/error-only watchdog; no progress milestones or heartbeat for an expected one-to-two-hour oracle
operations.callback: Terminal success asks @Codex to verify hashes and gates, seal notes, and continue only with the causally authorized successor. Failure asks @Codex to diagnose and repair only if the frozen experiment remains valid.
